## TableColumn.align property

The alignment of the column. Possible values: - `left` - left aligned - `center` - center aligned - `right` - right aligned - `start` - aligned to the start of the column - `end` - aligned to the end of the column

**Signature:**

```typescript
align?: CanvasTextAlign;
```
